status.leer: The stall is empty — put something on it before Saturday!
status.wartet: All set! Saturday at 8 it’s go time.
status.laeuft: Market day is happening right now!
status.fertig: Market day is over — pick up your earnings!

kommentar.1: Fresh from the garden! Well… most of it. The stall only wobbles a little.
kommentar.2: Bodo says this is the best spot on the whole market. Bodo says that about every spot.
kommentar.3: The whole square smells like harvest today. And a tiny bit like pumpkin.

kraeuter.ertrag: Your herb box added {n}× herb bundle!

erste_male.text: Before the market starts, stock the stall from your garden, workshop and travel finds, and set a price per item — up to half above or below its base value. On Saturday the market day runs on its own: cheaper sells faster, and every sold unit fills the crowd up a little. Watch it live or just collect the summary later — anything unsold goes back into storage.

lager.leer: Nothing to sell — harvest, craft or bring something home!

markttag.laeuft: The market is in full swing — watch it or settle up right away?
markttag.fertig: All customers came through. Time to settle up!

replay.vorbei: A customer eyes {name}… and moves on.

abrechnung.nichts: Nobody bought anything today. Next Saturday will be better!
abrechnung.rueck: Everything unsold is back in your storage.

markt.schuerze: The apron? The apron is business. NOBODY buys from a stall without an apron.
